desc: The M&P M2.0 Spec Series VI features like in-line ported barrel, Quad in-line porting strategically designed to divert gas upward reduces felt recoil without adding overall length to the barrel; direct mount slide for Aimpoint ACRO P-2 lowers optic height while providing a plate free connection; Floyds Custom Shop EDC Magwell assists in quick magazine insertion while also providing a grip ledge; flat-face trigger; 18 degree grip angle and 3-Dot White sights. Includes Aimpoint ACRO P-2 red dot sight, three 15rd magazines, Savior Equipment pistol bag, four interchangeable palmswell grip inserts, Floyds Custom Shop EDC magwell & EDC baseplate, Hunter Constantine carry belt, S&W Spec Series VI knife, coin and patch.
